title: Modern Industrialization Explosivity
description: Allows explosives in Modern Industrialization to explode. Modern fork of "Modern Nuclearization"
body:
## This is a fork of [Modern Nuclearization](https://modrinth.com/mod/mi-nukes), licensed under GPL-3.0-only.

This fork's purpose and overall functionality is the same as the original mod, but with some changes, fixes and random additions:
- **Compatibility with Create Aeronautics**
  - in the original mod, diagrams will not render on physics contraptions, and have issues being interacted with. this is now fixed
- Industrial TNT can be ignited, with a configurable strength
- Nuke can be armed and defused
  - strength and radius of explosion can be configured
  - "water grid" effect after explosion is fixed
  - nukes now detonate with a configurable timer
  - "scorch" zone has been added
  - radiation now occurs for all entities in blast zone
  - radiation zones have a yellow-green hue
- Sound changes
  - nuke explosion modified to a softer but equally powerful sound
  - nuke defuse sound
  - nuke countdown sound

## Credits
The original mod [Modern Nuclearization](https://modrinth.com/mod/mi-nukes), implementation of HBM's nuclear code, and its item textures.

## Disclaimer
The nuke, of course, is very laggy if the strength is set to a high value, future updates will consist of optimizing it a bit.
